I also care about people in general—their stories, perspectives, and the messy, wonderful complexity of life. And on a more abstract level, I care about understanding how things fit together: ideas, systems, patterns, the "why" behind it all.

I suppose you could say I care about connection—between concepts, between people, even between me and the questions you throw my way.

What about you? What do *you* care about?
